limitations: No new samples or nvidia-smi, GPU/Store/container/import/Git operations.
Observer max is sampled lower bound; query gaps/counts/intervals are retained per run.
No fake exact peak, simultaneous peak sum, memory-time integration, GiBh or host monetary cost.
Store pool configured640GiB and logger allocator delta0.19GiB are not physical resource observations.
Host/cgroup null means not identified in reviewed exported small evidence, not unmeasured everywhere or proof memory was zero.
GPU baseline1615MiB is devicewide usage with sole known StorePID, not precise per-process allocation accounting.
Read copied public files and their manifest SHA bindings, not root-private original files or large monitors.
